Create a professional character reference sheet. Match the EXACT visual style of the reference (realism level, rendering, texture, color treatment, aesthetic).

This is the SAME CHARACTER across ALL 7 panels. NOT different people.

- LEFT PROFILE: Perfect 90° facing left, same A-pose
- RIGHT PROFILE: Perfect 90° facing right, same A-pose
- BACK: Facing away, same A-pose

| FRONT PORTRAIT | LEFT PORTRAIT | RIGHT PORTRAIT |

- FRONT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, facing camera, neutral expression
- LEFT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, 90° profile facing left
- RIGHT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, 90° profile facing right

- Full-body views: heads at identical height, same scale
- Portraits: faces at identical scale, same crop level
- Portraits centered beneath full-body row
- Even spacing between all panels
- Clean panel separation with thin lines

**TECHNICAL:**
- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] plain background
- Consistent lighting across ALL panels (same direction, intensity, softness)
- Natural controlled shadows — detail preservation, no dramatic mood
- Sharp details, crisp edges, print-ready quality
- Accurate anatomy, clear silhouettes
- NO TEXT, NO LABELS

SAME CHARACTER in all 7 panels — perfect identity consistency.
